mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 0.5% signals an accommodative monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 7.0% signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending power and corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE exceeds 7.0%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts and retail sales signal a contraction in consumer demand that reduces corporate revenue expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or Rank IC for joint signal remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: High inflation combined with rising interest rates signals a monetary tightening cycle that increases corporate borrowing costs and reduces equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL exceeds 3.0% and FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.0%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production below 95.0 signals weakening manufacturing activity that reduces corporate profits and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO is below 95.0, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts falling below 900.0 signals a collapse in the housing market that reduces consumer wealth and spending, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when HOUST falls below 900.0, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Sustained inflation above 2.5% signals persistent inflation that prompts restrictive monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL exceeds 2.5%, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in employment growth and rising unemployment signal a severe labor market contraction that reduces consumer income and spending, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS declines and UNRATE rises, or Rank IC for joint signal falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
